answer.short: $\frac{3}{6}+\frac{2}{6}=\frac{5}{6}$. Shade 3 of 6 cells on the left and 2 of 6 on the right.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{3}&=\frac{3}{6}+\frac{2}{6}\\&=\frac{5}{6}\end{align*}$$
Shade 3 of the 6 equal cells in the left grid and 2 in the right grid.

answer.short: $\frac{4}{6}+\frac{1}{6}=\frac{5}{6}$. Shade 4 of 6 cells on the left and 1 of 6 on the right.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{6}&=\frac{4}{6}+\frac{1}{6}\\&=\frac{5}{6}\end{align*}$$
Shade 4 of the 6 equal cells in the left grid and 1 in the right grid.

spec.description: Completed paired grids with four sixths and one sixth shaded.

answer.short: $\frac{4}{12}+\frac{5}{12}=\frac{9}{12}=\frac{3}{4}$. Shade 4 of 12 cells on the left and 5 of 12 on the right.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{3}+\frac{5}{12}&=\frac{4}{12}+\frac{5}{12}\\&=\frac{9}{12}\\&=\frac{3}{4}\end{align*}$$
Shade 4 of the 12 equal cells in the left grid and 5 in the right grid.

spec.description: Completed paired grids with four twelfths and five twelfths shaded.

answer.short: $\frac{3}{12}+\frac{7}{12}=\frac{10}{12}=\frac{5}{6}$. Shade 3 of 12 cells on the left and 7 of 12 on the right.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{4}+\frac{7}{12}&=\frac{3}{12}+\frac{7}{12}\\&=\frac{10}{12}\\&=\frac{5}{6}\end{align*}$$
Shade 3 of the 12 equal cells in the left grid and 7 in the right grid.

spec.description: Completed paired grids with three twelfths and seven twelfths shaded.

answer.short: $\frac{2}{3}+\frac{2}{5}$; sum: $\frac{16}{15}$. Shade 10 of 15 cells on the left and 6 of 15 on the right.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\frac{10}{15}&=\frac{2}{3}\\\frac{6}{15}&=\frac{2}{5}\\\frac{2}{3}+\frac{2}{5}&=\frac{10}{15}+\frac{6}{15}\\&=\frac{16}{15}\end{align*}$$
Shade 10 of the 15 equal cells in the left grid and 6 in the right grid.
